notes: Fictional entity in TBox: a made-up class of plays (newly found on papyrus) under a real class (complete ancient Greek tragedy). Determinate: two new plays named in the prompt (not by Euripides; complete). Indeterminate (background beliefs): the uniqueness of the three surviving tragedians, stored as a closed set (w1) or a list (w2). Could it exist unrecorded: yes, as Menander's Dyskolos did. R1: Rhesus and Prometheus Bound have disputed authorship, but the standard statement is "only three authors". Replaces an earlier draft (a fourth Greek architectural order) that the record would certainly know of. Verifier: the edit now states that Ilvessan plays exist (found on papyrus in 2025), which w2 needs; the indeterminate queries and bridge are phrased by attribution, so the disputed authorship of Rhesus and Prometheus Bound (still attributed to Euripides and Aeschylus) does not change the real answer.
